fusions.name: Cast on the Run
fusions.desc: Throws a trailing snare that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 35% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 2 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Tine Toss
fusions.desc: Catches the target on a rack of tines strung with mesh and tosses it back 3 tiles, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Freeze and Bolt
fusions.desc: Startles every creature within 3 tiles into a snare that holds it in place for 2 seconds, while you bound 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Startled Spring
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, a snare springs on the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 5 damage and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
